segments.text: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
segments.speaker: Job
